source.title: Londonderry Sentinel, 30 April 1936, p. 2 ("Limavady Rural Council nominations")
source.publisher: Londonderry Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Londonderry Sentinel 30 Apr 1936 p2, read in the page image: 'there will be a contest in three divisions - Drum, Drumsurn, and Faughanvale - while in six divisions no nominations were received. Of the remaining fourteen nominations, twelve are in respect of old councillors, who will thus be returned unopposed, and the other two are newcomers'.

note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Co. Londonderry took place on Tuesday 2 June 1936 and Mr. A. Mitchell, returning officer, declared the results on Wednesday 3 June. Three of the twenty-three divisions were contested; the rest were filled at the nominations. Filed on 1936-06-02, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Londonderry that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Fourteen further divisions were filled unopposed at nomination (Londonderry Sentinel, 30 April 1936, p. 2). The six divisions with no nomination (Ballykelly, Bellarena, Benone, Feeny, Glenshane, Straw) are recorded from the Derry Journal's reports of the new council's meetings (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Printed '(new)'. Returned unopposed.
